async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Reports' link to expand the reports menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Reports")
    await reports_link.click()
    # Wait for the menu to expand
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Now click the 'Customers by number of orders' link under Reports
    customers_by_orders_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Customers by number of orders")
    await customers_by_orders_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
